acceptance_criteria: SmartConsole style unified cluster interface table showing physical, VLAN, and sync interfaces with member IPs and cluster VIPs
Unified cluster routing table highlighting matching identical routes and differentiating non-identical routes with DIFF status
Check Point clish fallback implemented for interface and route extraction when GAIA API is unavailable
Pre-flight TCP port 22/443 check implemented to fail fast instead of hanging on SSH timeouts
Worker claim loop concurrency expanded to 10 parallel claim loops
Frontend and backend unit tests pass with zero regressions

baseline.observed: Cluster view displayed separate disconnected tables per member. Bulk collection hung sequentially due to single-threaded worker loop and full SSH timeouts on unreachable IP addresses.
baseline.what_exists: Single worker thread claim loop. Interface and routing parsers were member-isolated without cross-member matrix unification.

report.objective: Implement SmartConsole unified cluster interface matrix, route diff comparisons, TCP pre-check, and 10-worker claim loop concurrency.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Cluster topology unification and worker concurrency

requirements: Implement SmartConsole unified cluster interface matrix in ClusterInterfacesTab
Implement unified cluster routing view with DIFF indicators in ClusterRoutingTab
Add clish fallback in Check Point inventory extraction
Add pre-flight TCP port 22/443 ping probe in worker transport
Increase Ui2WorkerMain thread pool to 10 parallel worker claim loops
risks: Ensuring worker thread pool does not exceed database connection pool limit
